title: Next.js Performance Patterns for Client Dashboards
excerpt: Steps for Core Web Vitals, server component boundaries, image strategy, and animation budgets on data-heavy React applications.
body:
## Start with the server boundary

Push data fetching to Server Components. Keep client components small and interactive-only.

## Images and fonts

Use next/image with real sizes. Subset fonts. Avoid layout shift on dashboards.

## Animation budget

Animate opacity and transform. Skip layout thrash on large tables.
